findings.title: Past reminders are deleted before cancelled reminders are cancelled
findings.body: The handler first deletes all EMAIL workflowReminders with scheduledDate <= now (lines 34-41), then later queries for cancelled reminders to cancel at SendGrid (lines 44-51). A reminder cancelled shortly before its scheduledDate can therefore be removed by the first deleteMany when the next 15-minute cron tick runs after the scheduledDate, and the SendGrid scheduled send is never told to cancel, so the unwanted email can still be sent. Cancel processing should run before the past-date deletion, or near-term cancellations should be sent to SendGrid immediately.

findings.title: Immediate SendGrid cancellation leaves no retry state
findings.body: When immediateDelete is true, the function sends the SendGrid cancellation request and returns without deleting the workflowReminder or setting cancelled=true. If the request fails, the caught error is only logged, the row remains with cancelled null, and the regular CRON cancellation query will never retry it because it is not marked cancelled. For rescheduled bookings this can still allow the old scheduled email to be sent after a transient SendGrid error. Set cancelled=true before attempting the immediate cancellation or delete the row only after success with retry semantics.

findings.title: Old workflow reminders are cancelled before reschedule succeeds
findings.body: The new block cancels/deletes the original booking's workflow reminders before calling eventManager.reschedule and before checking whether it succeeded. If reschedule fails, the original booking remains but its reminders are already gone, so the user no longer receives the reminders they should still get. Only cancel old reminders after a successful reschedule, or recreate them on failure.

findings.title: Workflow reminder cancellation is fire-and-forget
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are async, but their promises are not collected or awaited. The previous code at least awaited the Prisma deletes. As a result, the handler can return success before Twilio/SendGrid cancellation and DB cleanup complete, and failures are swallowed with no retry. Collect the promises and await them before returning.

findings.title: Paid bookings return before scheduled workflow reminders are cancelled
findings.body: The paid/refund branch returns at line 464 before the updatedBookings workflow-reminder cancellation block at lines 484-493. Scheduled BEFORE_EVENT/AFTER_EVENT reminders for paid bookings are left untouched and can still be sent after the booking is cancelled/rejected. Move the workflow-reminder cancellation before this early return or restructure the early return.
